page.title: Creator & Affiliate Program
page.body_html:
We're looking for pet content creators who care about wellness, comfort, and senior pet care as much as we do.

If you create content about grooming, pet health, or everyday pet care — and you'd genuinely use products like ours — we'd love to work with you.

What you get: a commission on sales you drive, early access to new products, and creative freedom. We're not looking for scripted reads — we want your honest take.

Tell us a bit about yourself and your content using the form below, including your handle(s), approximate follower count, and a link to a few recent posts. We personally review every application and follow up by email.
